title: Aromatic Turkish Lentil Stew
description: This hearty Turkish lentil stew is a comforting and flavorful dish, featuring the unique taste of tamarind paste and a hint of mustard, perfect for a sick day. It is an ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe that combines sautéed vegetables and red lentils in a rich and aromatic broth.
instructions: In a large pot, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic in a little bit of oil over medium heat until they are softened.
Add the chopped carrots to the pot and continue to cook for a few minutes until they start to tenderize.
Stir in the tamarind paste, mustard, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed and drained red lentils to the pot, along with the vegetable broth, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let the stew simmer for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the beaten eggs and continue to cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the eggs are fully incorporated and the stew has thickened slightly.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
